standard: Each row is a question a reader who has NOT read the note could ask. `expect` lists the minimally sufficient evidence paths; `evidence` quotes what in the note answers it; `why_not_tautology` names the query words that do not occur in the expected note; `absent_terms_share` is the measured share of content terms that do not occur in it (prefix-5 stem match, stopword-filtered, no judgement). `axes` places every row on nine axes so a failure can be attributed; `pair` marks the rows that differ in exactly one axis. `measured` is the live engine's answer on 2026-11-16 (scope own, limit 20): rank of the first expected path, page width, top hit's matched_terms, and whether tb_grep finds the query literally.

axes_enum.form_note: path and code shapes live in `noise` under form=silly, because the class label is silly for every noise row
